countries.reasoning: China is the dominant producer of Germanium based on USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2024; production is well-documented with stable output over recent years.
Russia has notable Germanium production as a byproduct of zinc refining; USGS data and industry reports confirm significance but with some variability in reports.
The US produces Germanium mainly from zinc ores and coal fly ash; USGS reports provide reliable data, production has been stable.
Belgium has significant refining and some production capacity; data is moderately available from industry sources but less detailed on mining vs. recycling.
Canada contributes to global supply primarily as a secondary producer; detailed production data is limited but considered consistent in recent reports.
